svg.aria-label: The stack, under test. Client: built with React, Next.js, Tailwind; tested for XSS, content security policy, secure cookies. Edge: Vercel, Render, TLS; tested for TLS setup, security headers, CORS. API: Spring Boot, Express, NestJS, FastAPI; tested for injection, input validation, rate limits. Auth: Spring Security, BCrypt, sessions, JWT; tested for broken authentication, IDOR, access control. Data: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Prisma; tested for parameterized queries, least privilege, secrets.
